answer.reason: The verses tell of this Pharaoh's oppression of Israel, his decree against the newborn sons, and his pursuit of Moses.

clauses.english: set taskmasters over Israel to afflict them with burdens
clauses.quote: set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens

clauses.english: commanded that every newborn son be cast into the river
clauses.quote: Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river

clauses.english: sought to slay Moses, who fled from him to Midian

doubts: EXO 1:11 says 'they' set the taskmasters, so the Egyptians generally may be meant rather than Pharaoh himself.
The verses about Pharaoh's daughter (EXO 2:5-10, ACT 7:21, HEB 11:24) concern her, not this Pharaoh, and were left out.
EXO 18:4 and ACT 7:18 may refer to a different Pharaoh or king, so they were left out; EXO 2:23 (the king's death) was left out as the least defining.
